name: HBL Engineering Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, HBL Engineering is an Indian research-driven manufacturing company that specializes in developing indigenous, cost-effective technology solutions—such as specialized batteries and railway safety systems—for critical global industries. The company is now expanding its focus toward domestic electric mobility solutions, including high-efficiency motors and drivetrain systems. [1]
key_points: Business Segments: [1] HBL has developed 3 business segments, leveraging its engineering for technology development. a) Industrial Electronics Segment: [2] Three Business Units (FY26 ~ 49% vs FY25 ~15%) - Rail Signalling, Kavach, TMS/CTC: [3] Kavach contributed ~50% of sales in FY 26, and this trend should continue in FY27 and FY28, and potentially decline from FY29. - Electric Drive trains: (Motors & Batteries vehicle electronics for Trucks +maritime) [4] Due to supply chain hurdles with permanent magnets, HBL redesigned motors to be magnet -less, creating a 9-month delay. Approval for 55 T trucks is now expected by March 2027, with a pilot sales targeted for July 2027 Driven by government initiatives to clean up water ways, HBL and Cochin Shipyard incorporated Green Maritime Propulsion Pvt Ltd in June 2026 to supply marine-standard electric drive trains for ferries and tugboats, initial sales expected through September 2027 while meeting marine certifications [4] - Other Industrial Electronics Products : Now in exploratory/R&D stage.

profile.summary: HBL Engineering Limited manufactures and sells batteries and other products in India and internationally. It operates through Industrial batteries, Defense and Aviation batteries, and Electronics segments. The company offers lead acid batteries, nickel-cadmium batteries, silver zinc batteries, defence, and lithium batteries. It also provides rail signaling electronics, electronic fuzes for ammunition, train collision avoidance systems, train management system, and electric drive trains. The company serves system integrators, EPC's, railway, aviation, and defense companies, as well as government sector. The company was formerly HBL Power Systems Limited and changed its name to HBL Engineering Limited in November 2024. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India. HBL Engineering Limited is a subsidiary of Aluru Family Private Trust.
